messages:
Alex W: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: triaged alert flood from redis-kv evictions, muted duplicate pager, filed ticket INF-342.
Mira S: Thanks. Which pager was noisy?
Alex W: The rule 'kv-eviction-noisy' — oncall-bot showed repeated flaps. I muted it for 20m while digging.
Oncall Bot: Notice: Muting 'kv-eviction-noisy' until +20m.
Samir: FYI I rolled a config tweak to canary nodes last night (maxmemory-policy -> volatile-lru). Could be related.
Lee R: Any customer impact? latency or errors?
Alex W: No user-facing errors reported. Saw a small tail latency bump on canary (~95th +8ms). Keeping rollback threshold at 2% error-rate.
Mira S: I'll prepare an alert tuning proposal: aggregate by cluster and increase the for: window. Proposed snippet: 
```
alert: KVCacheEvictionHigh
expr: sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (cluster) / sum(kv_keys_total) by (cluster) > 0.01
for: 10m
```
Samir: +1 to aggregation. Also note: if we roll back, oncall will need to run manual cache-warm script.
Alex W: Blocker: can't reproduce eviction locally; need access to canary logs (p-logs role). @Mira S can you grant p-logs to me? :pray: 
Mira S: Granted. IAM ticket #IAM-1207 created and resolved.
Lee R: Today I will finish the kv-eviction runbook draft, push the alert tuning PR, and add a rollback automation CR.
Samir: I'll check post-deploy metrics at 10:30 PT and add a smoke test to the canary job.
Alex W: Also small ops ask: update SLO doc — suggest lowering the error-budget-burn alert threshold from 0.8 -> 0.5 to catch regressions earlier.
Mira S: Sounds reasonable. I'll open PR ops/alerts#219 with the change and link to the canary dashboard.
Lee R: Tagging for visibility: @oncall-team.
Oncall Bot: Heads up: Handoff reminder scheduled at 17:00 local. :bell:
Alex W: I'll be offline after 13:00 today (reachable for Sev1 only).
Mira S: Noted. I'll consolidate notes into INF-343 and move to triage with action items: alert tune, runbook PR, IAM confirmation, rollback automation CR.
Samir: No more from me.
Lee R: 👍
Alex W: :thumbsup:
